title: Chapter 33
content:
The party was held at a private lakeside villa out in Gapyeong. The estate belonged to Choi Ki-tae, featuring a massive swimming pool dead-center in the courtyard—sprawling enough to easily accommodate a dozen or more people. The moment Kang Seok-joo arrived, he stripped down to his swim trunks and dove right in, laughing raucously as he splashed water over the girls.

"How have you been holding up?"

As Jakyeong cracked open a bottle of mineral water, someone slid onto the lounger beside him. It was the high-fashion model from the club whose father was a heavyweight in the legal sector. Dressed in a revealing halter-neck minidress, she pressed flush against his side, a lavish diamond necklace sparkling over her generous cleavage.

Sweeping her long hair over one shoulder, she offered a sultry smile. "New glasses? They look so much better on you."

"Ah... thank you."

"When do you head back to Hong Kong?"

"In about ten days."

"What a shame. I fly to Hong Kong for shopping all the time—can I get your number so I can call you privately?"

She leaned in closer as she spoke, her skin soft and warm against his arm. Angling her upper body forward, her deep cleavage was on full display. When he stared, she took it as an invitation, wrapping her arms around his bicep and boldly pressing her full chest against him. Jakyeong didn't pull away.

Normally, such brazen physical contact would have stirred a natural reaction, yet strangely enough, he felt completely numb. The realization hit him like a lightning bolt.

I got rock-hard just watching Kang Il-hyun stroke his own cock... yet I'm feeling dead nothing around a woman this stunning?

A sharp snap of fingers sounded right next to his ear.

Jakyeong turned to find Choi Ki-tae looming over them. Glaring at the model with undisguised irritation, Ki-tae wedged himself between them and dropped onto the lounger.

Pushed aside, the woman backed off with a venomous scowl. "Ugh, lunatic."

"He's my personal guest. Beat it."

Ki-tae waved a dismissive hand, and the woman rolled her eyes before strutting back to her circle of friends.

Jakyeong watched her retreating figure with a look of existential shock. She's breathtaking... so why didn't my body respond at all?

Noticing the look of devastation on his face, Ki-tae waved a hand in front of his eyes. "What's that look for? Did I just ruin your game?"

Shaking off the daze, Jakyeong quickly shook his head. "No... not at all."

Ki-tae glanced at the water bottle in Jakyeong's hand. "Not a fan of champagne? Want me to grab you something else?"

"No, I'm fine... I don't really drink."

"Ah, what a pity."

The remark carried a distinctly suggestive undertone. Jakyeong took a sip of water, pretending not to notice.

Over in the pool, Seok-joo—a joint dangling from his lips while riding piggyback on a friend's shoulders—violently shook a bottle of vintage champagne. The cork blew into the night air, spraying a shower of sparkling wine across the patio. Ki-tae reflexively threw up a hand to shield him, but a second too late; Jakyeong was drenched in sticky alcohol.

"Crazy bastard," Ki-tae muttered, brushing the wet droplets from Jakyeong's shirt. "You alright?"

"Yes..."

In the basin, Seok-joo chugged the champagne straight from the bottle before spraying the rest over the shrieking women. Watching him waste bottles worth thousands of dollars like tap water was surreal—the kid was completely out of his mind. Clusters of guests wrestled and shoved each other into the water, bursting into fits of hysterical laughter. If one subtracted the heavy narcotics from the equation, they almost looked like innocent youth having harmless fun.

"This won't do," Ki-tae said, turning to Jakyeong. "Let's go inside so you can change."

"I'm really alright—"

"Come on. Besides, I have something private to give you."

Ki-tae's eyes darkened with unmistakable intent.

Jakyeong gripped his water bottle, putting on a hesitant, deliberating expression. Fortunately, Park Tae-soo was stationed outside the main gate on security detail. Rather than trying to slip off-property and risk getting caught by Tae-soo, wrapping up his business here was tactically sound.

Offering a meek nod, Jakyeong stood, following Ki-tae inside.

Discarded joints and plastic baggies of powder littered the villa floor. They headed up to the second floor, the open mezzanine overlooking the sunken living room below—where a couple stripped from the waist down was openly having sex on the leather sectional.

Ki-tae barked a laugh. "Fuck's sake! Take it to a bedroom!"

The girl riding on top raised a middle finger at him without breaking her rhythm. Lewd, heavy moans echoed from several closed doors along the corridor.

Ki-tae guided him to the master suite at the end of the hall. The moment the door clicked shut, the external racket was completely sealed off. The suite was furnished with a king bed, a sofa, and an attached en-suite bath—less of a vacation room and more of a purpose-built den for casual hookups.

While Jakyeong scanned the layout, Ki-tae moved to a mini-bar in the corner, pouring two tumblers of dark, high-proof liquor. Standard predator playbook.

Ki-tae set a glass in front of him, gesturing for him to drink.

"I... I really can't handle hard alcohol..."

"Just one sip. It's clean—no gear in it, I swear."

Jakyeong brought the crystal rim to his lips, took a microscopic taste, and pinched his features in visible disgust. Ki-tae chuckled in delight before throwing his own drink back in a single gulp. A heavy gold ring set with a gaudy gemstone caught the light on his finger.

Grinning at Jakyeong's sour expression, he murmured, "You've got this insanely seductive face, yet you can't even hold your liquor. Makes you even cuter."

When Jakyeong looked up, Ki-tae offered a casual shrug. "Sorry if that offended you. But you really are filthy gorgeous. Especially those eyes. Don't tell me you don't know that about yourself?"

Lighting a cigarette, Ki-tae blew a stream of smoke toward the ceiling. Jakyeong rested his hands flat on his knees, staring down at the untouched liquor. As a child, he’d taken countless savage beatings for "glaring" at the thugs around him, all because of these very eyes. His father had hated the dead look in them so much he’d once tried to carve them out with a paring knife.

"You didn't really contact me just to buy gear, did you?" Ki-tae asked, his tone dropping into a conspiratorial purr.

Jakyeong kept silent, letting his chin drop with deliberate shyness. As he fidgeted with his fingers in feigned nervousness, Ki-tae slid closer on the couch, catching Jakyeong's hand before offering a lit joint.

"Want a drag?"

Jakyeong hesitated, took a shallow pull, and broke into a delicate coughing fit. Chuckling, Ki-tae crushed the joint in an ashtray, leaning in close. The pungent stench of cannabis rolled off him as his mouth closed in.

Jakyeong turned his head at the last fraction of a second, bracing a palm firmly against Ki-tae's chest. "Can... can you shower first?"

Ki-tae's eyes narrowed. "I'm completely clean. Want me to prove it?"

As Ki-tae reached for his belt buckle, Jakyeong caught his wrist, giving a firm shake of his head. "I... I'll only do it if you shower first..."

Faced with such clear resistance, Ki-tae clicked his tongue in mild annoyance and pushed himself up. "Fine, wait right here. I'll make it quick."

Tossing his phone and cigarette pack onto the side table, Ki-tae vanished into the bathroom. The door closed, followed by the steady rush of running water.

Jakyeong immediately wiped the back of his hand across his mouth, spitting on the floor in pure disgust. Reaching into his inner jacket pocket, he drew out a high-speed data cloning cable, connecting Ki-tae's smartphone to his own secondary burner device.

A full data mirror took approximately ten minutes. He prayed Ki-tae would take his time, but with the man already revved up, he was bound to rush out sooner.

Jakyeong’s eyes darted between the progress bar on the screen and the bathroom door. Barely five minutes had passed when the shower cut out.

Damn it. Still five minutes left on the clone.

The door handle rattled. Springing up from the sofa, Jakyeong quickly undid the top buttons of his shirt and moved over to the edge of the mattress. Right on cue, Ki-tae stepped out, wearing nothing but a towel wrapped low around his waist.

The sight of Jakyeong sitting on the bed with his shirt casually parted sent a wave of raw lust washing over Ki-tae's face. He strode over, planting a hand on either side of Jakyeong's thighs with a feral grin.

"Look at that. Made me wash up, but you couldn't even wait to hop in bed yourself, could you, kitten?"

Ink coiled across his bare skin—the goblin tattoo on his arm, and a snarling wolf across his chest. Ki-tae leaned down, his mouth seeking Jakyeong's. When Jakyeong turned his face away, Ki-tae’s mouth descended onto his exposed neck instead, his tongue dragging wetly over the skin.

Jakyeong’s expression twisted in pure, visceral revulsion. He’d endured Kang Il-hyun twice, but having this filthy degenerate slobber over his skin was unbearable. As Ki-tae clamped down, sucking hard on his throat, Jakyeong checked his wristwatch.

Done. Ten minutes.

Jakyeong shoved Ki-tae's shoulders with explosive force, knocking the man back onto the mattress.

Ki-tae stared at him in utter disbelief. "What the hell?"

The skin on his collarbone stung where the man had clamped down. "I'm sorry... I can't do this."

Ki-tae's features contorted into a dark, venomous scowl. Raking a hand through his damp hair, he cursed under his breath. "You playing fucking games with me?"

"I'm truly sorry."

As Jakyeong slid toward the edge of the bed, Ki-tae grabbed his arm, slamming him roughly back down onto the sheets. Just as Jakyeong debated whether to snap the bastard's windpipe right then and there, a frantic pounding shook the suite door.

"Ki-tae! Open up! We got a situation out here, man! Open the damn door!"

"For fuck's sake..."

Sensing they might kick the frame in, Ki-tae stormed over and wrenched the door open. A cluster of drunken friends spilled inside, babbling over one another in a chaotic frenzy.

Seizing the distraction, Jakyeong darted to the side table, unplugged the cloning cable, stashed the burner in his back pocket, and left Ki-tae's phone untouched.

Ki-tae glanced over his shoulder, their eyes meeting for a brief heartbeat. Flashing an apologetic, frightened smile, Jakyeong slipped past the commotion and darted out into the hall. Ignoring Ki-tae calling after him, he hurried downstairs to the pool, flagging down Kang Seok-joo.

"I'm heading out first. I'm completely exhausted."

"What? Already?"

"Yeah... Have fun."

On his way through the courtyard, the model waved a disappointed goodbye. Jakyeong offered a brief nod and cleared the gates.

Park Tae-soo stepped out of the idling sedan to meet him, but his expression carried an odd, unreadable sharpness.

Pausing near the car, Jakyeong caught his reflection in the side mirror. A coin-sized, angry crimson hickey was branded vividly across the side of his neck.

He squeezed his eyes shut. If he could have marched back inside and pulverized Ki-tae's skull, he would have done it in a heartbeat, but being unable to blow his cover left his blood simmering with raw frustration.

Straightening up, he found Park Tae-soo staring directly at the mark with an intense, calculating gaze. Feeling exposed, Jakyeong opened the rear door and slipped inside without a word.

Translator's Notes (A/N):

  • Gapyeong Villas (가평 별장): Gapyeong is a picturesque, mountainous county located in Gyeonggi Province along the Bukhan River, famous as a premier weekend getaway spot for wealthy Seoulites, luxury pensions, and private party retreats.
